storyworld_title: Murder at First and Last Men: Escape from the Solar Cul-de-sac

about_text.value: A murder mystery remix of First and Last Men: Escape from the Solar Cul-de-sac.

characters.name: The Counter Archivist
characters.description: A patient anti-institution that keeps a mirror-ledger of power: it cancels quiet influence with evidence, leaks, and paradox-proof memory.

characters.name: The Mediator
characters.description: A broker of uneasy settlements who tracks public sentiment and timing windows.

text_script.value: Civilization studies the room where The Counter Archivist's absence has become the central fact. Civilization offers a polished memory, but the adaptation's older themes keep leaking through the furniture, gestures, and alibis. The player must decide whether to preserve the obvious murder frame, follow a symbolic clue, or pressure the witness until the scene exposes its second story.
